task_completion.description: Create enclosed zones for driver lounge, security office, and public restrooms using partition walls.
task_completion.visual_evidence: New wall segments visible in the 2D floor plan view creating distinct enclosed rooms within the building shell.

task_completion.description: Define and name all rooms: 'Waiting Hall', 'Ticketing', 'Driver Lounge', 'Security', and 'Restrooms'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text labels for each of the five specific room names visible on the 2D floor plan.

task_completion.description: Furnish concourse with 20+ benches/chairs, 3 ticketing desks, and 2 digital arrival monitors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A high density of seating icons (at least 20), three desk objects in the ticketing area, and two screen/monitor objects on walls or stands.

task_completion.description: Equip driver lounge (2 sofas/armchairs + appliance) and security office (workstation + monitor).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Furniture icons representing sofas/armchairs and a kitchen appliance (e.g., fridge/coffee machine) in the lounge; a desk and screen in the security room.

task_completion.description: Ensure public restrooms contain at least 4 toilets and 4 sinks total.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least 4 toilet icons and 4 sink/washbasin icons placed within the designated restroom area.

task_completion.description: Add at least 3 dimension lines documenting walkway widths or seating clearances.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At least three dimension annotation lines (showing measurements) placed in walkways or between furniture.

task_completion.description: Save the completed layout to the current file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon being clicked or the 'File' menu showing 'Save' selected, with no 'unsaved changes' asterisk in the title bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, drag-and-drop actions from the furniture catalog, and use of the wall drawing tool visible in screenshots.

integrity.description: The agent did not use command-line scripts to generate the .sh3d file content directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not used to execute complex scripts that bypass the GUI design process.

integrity.description: The layout shows incremental progress rather than a sudden appearance of a finished file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show walls being drawn and furniture being placed one by one.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires specific counts: 20+ seats, 3 ticketing desks, 2 monitors, 2 sofas/armchairs, 1 appliance, 1 workstation, 1 security monitor, 4 toilets, and 4 sinks. Five specific room names must be present. The starter file is 'bus_terminal_starter.sh3d'. ADA compliance is verified by the presence of at least 3 dimension lines.
